0022600021.text: The Houston Rockets (4-0, 1st in the Southwest) visit the Dallas Mavericks (2-2, 8th in the West) in their sixth game of the season and the Emirates NBA Cup West Group A. Houston leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 128-110 win in Houston on October 21, and the teams split their 2025-26 meetings 2-2. Houston is without Alperen Sengun (back soreness), Marcus Smart (forearm strain), and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Naji Marshall (illness), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation).
